scholarships.title: Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines

scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters

scholarships.title: Chevening ASEAN Scholarship

scholarships.description: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships are for candidates from eligible lower and upper middle income Commonwealth countries, to undertake full-time taught Master’s study at a UK university. Funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO).

scholarships.description: Master’s Scholarships enable talented and motivated individuals from low and middle income Commonwealth countries to gain the knowledge and skills required for sustainable development. Candidates are nominated for this award through a nominating agency.

scholarships.title: CSC Research Impact Awards
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK

Winners receive grants, prizes of £1,500, or professional resources.

scholarships.description: The Swedish Institute (SI) offers fully funded scholarships for master's level studies in Sweden. The program includes 'Global Professionals' for those aiming to advance sustainable growth and societal change, and 'Pioneering Women in STEM' to empower women in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. Scholarship holders join the SI Network for Global Professionals (NFGP).

scholarships.title: Global Professionals
scholarships.description: A fully funded scholarship for professionals who want to advance sustainable growth and drive societal change in their home country.

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals is awarded to professionals with work and leadership experience, aiming to strengthen their capacity and competence to contribute to the sustainable development of their home countries. scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals offers fully-funded academic scholarships for master’s studies in Sweden for professionals with work and leadership experience who have the ambition to contribute to change in their home country and region.

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals is a fully-funded academic scholarship for master's studies in Sweden, covering both tuition fees and living costs.

scholarships.title: Pioneering Women in STEM
scholarships.description: The Pioneering Women in STEM scholarship supports women from selected countries in Africa and Asia who want to pursue full-time master's studies in Sweden. The program aims to empower women to lead innovation and contribute to sustainable development in their home countries.

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals is a fully-funded scholarship for master's studies in Sweden. It provides full tuition fee coverage, a monthly living allowance, and a travel grant. It aims to support professionals from selected countries who demonstrate leadership potential and an ambition to contribute to sustainable development in their home countries.

scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program
scholarships.description: The France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program is a tool developed by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract the best international students for master's and doctoral level studies.

scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
scholarships.description: The Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Program was established by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract top foreign students to enroll in their masters and PhD programs. It gives opportunity to the future foreign decision-makers of the private and public sectors, in priority areas of study, and encourages applicants from foreign countries up to 29 years old at master’s level, and applicants up to 35 years old at PhD level.

scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
scholarships.description: A prestigious program that provides support to foreign students selected by French institutions to pursue Master's or Doctoral level studies in France. It covers a monthly living allowance, tuition exemptions, and certain travel expenses.

scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs and French Ministry for Higher Education and Research
fields: Human, animal and ecosystem health (One Health approach)
scholarships.description: The Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA) visiting fellowship program supports early career researchers (holding a doctoral degree for less than 5 years) to carry out research in France on topics related to climate change and environmental issues. The fellowship includes a monthly allowance of 2,500 euros, a moving allowance, and health insurance.

scholarships.title: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES)
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES) programme supports high-calibre international students for one year of full-time study at NFQ levels 9 or 10. The scholarship includes a €10,000 stipend and a full fee waiver from the host institution. Applicants must be from outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom, excluding Russian and Belarusian nationals.

scholarships.title: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) Grant
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) is Ireland’s single national awarding authority for all higher and further education grants. It offers funding to eligible students in approved full-time third-level education in Ireland and, in some cases, for students studying outside of Ireland.

scholarships.title: Fund for Students with Disabilities (FSD)
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Fund for Students with Disabilities (FSD) assists higher education institutions in providing students with disabilities the necessary assistance and equipment to access, participate in, and complete their course of study. Funding is allocated to the college to provide supports such as assistive technology, non-medical helpers, academic support, and transport, rather than being paid directly to the student.

scholarships.title: Student Assistance Fund
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Student Assistance Fund provides financial support to full or part-time students who are experiencing financial difficulties while attending college. It is designed to provide a source of financial support in addition to a SUSI grant to help with costs such as books, class materials, rent, utility bills, food, travel, childcare, and medical costs.

scholarships.title: Back to Education Allowance
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Back to Education Allowance (BTEA) allows people who are unemployed, parenting alone, or have a disability and are receiving certain payments from the Department of Social Protection to take part in second- or third-level education courses while continuing to receive support.

scholarships.title: Free Fees Initiative
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Free Fees Initiative provides funding for tuition fees for eligible full-time undergraduate students undertaking approved courses in participating higher education institutions in Ireland. Students must meet specific nationality and residency requirements (ordinarily resident in an EU/EEA/Swiss State/UK for at least three of the five years preceding entry). Note that eligible students are still required to pay a student contribution charge.

scholarships.title: Postgraduate student funding (SUSI)

scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) funding is available for students to pursue postgraduate courses in approved institutions. The page also references tax relief available on postgraduate tuition fees.
